settings-details.drawer_text: Setting × PLANNER POLICY · MISTER_ENGAGE_KPA VPD Mister Engage Graph this setting › DEVICE 1.05 kPa · reported 19 s ago 0.50 2.50 Allowed 0.50–2.50 kPa · step 0.05 Released: plan, band or default applies next 0.95 kPa at Nov 7, 08:00 · AI House VPD above which the misters may start pulsing once humidifying has escalated to them. What it changes When the controller is humidifying past the fog stage, the misters pulse if the house VPD is above this value or any zone is drier than its crop target. They stop once no zone is dry and VPD falls below this value minus the mister hysteresis. Raising it The misters wait for drier air and stop sooner: less mister water, a drier house. Lowering it The misters start in less dry air and run longer: more water and humidity. While the house is dry-stressed, a value far above the VPD band high edge is pulled back toward that edge.
